description.describe_ch: 自從Simonson & Schmitt（1997）提出美學在行銷中的重要性以來，美學「輸出」在行銷和品牌建立中帶來的競爭優勢已被廣泛認可。課程將透過線上和線下渠道的案例向學生介紹如何透過視覺媒體傳達行銷訊息。
description.describe_eh: Since Simonson & Schmitt’s (1997) avocation of the importance of aesthetics in marketing, the competitive advantage that aesthetic output can bring in marketing and branding has been widely recognised. This course aims to introduce students the way in which the marketing message is conveyed via visual medium through case studies from online and offline channels. Through the process of reading visual materials, students are also introduced practical skills to recreate their own work.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂規則與提醒（Classroom Policies & Guidelines）
為營造尊重、多元與專業的學習環境，請同學遵守以下課堂規則：
1.出席與課堂參與
•	準時上課，並完整參與課堂活動。
•	若有特殊狀況需遲到或早退，請事先告知老師。
•	缺課需補交指定補充作業，以確保學習進度。
2.數位設備使用
•	鼓勵使用筆電或平板進行課堂筆記與設計練習。
•	非與課程無關之操作（如：社群滑手機、觀看影片等）請避免。
•	手機請設定靜音，上課期間不建議配戴耳機。
3.課堂互動與簡報
•	尊重同學發言，專心聆聽小組報告與簡報分享。
•	表達意見時以正向、專業且具建設性的態度為原則。
•	鼓勵多元觀點、包容差異，彼此尊重學習過程。
4.學術誠信原則
•	所有作業須為原創，不得抄襲、代筆或重複提交已交作品。
•	使用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT）輔助時，請註明用途與來源。
•	引用他人資料或設計時，請正確註明出處。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
Classroom Policies & Guidelines
To foster a respectful, diverse, and professional learning environment, students are expected to adhere to the following classroom rules：
1.Attendance and Classroom Participation
•	Be on time for class and actively participate in classroom activities. 
•	If you need to be late or leave early due to special circumstances, please inform the instructor in advance. 
•	If you miss a class, you must submit the designated supplementary assignments to ensure you stay on track with the course. 
2.Digital Device Usage 
•	Laptops or tablets are encouraged for note-taking and design exercises.
•	Please avoid non-course-related activities (e.g., browsing social media, watching videos).
•	Set your phone to silent, and wearing headphones during class is not recommended.
3. Class Interaction and Presentations
•	Respect your classmates' speaking time and actively listen to group reports and presentations.
•	When expressing opinions, maintain a positive, professional, and constructive attitude. 
•	Encourage diverse perspectives, embrace differences, and respect the learning process. 
4. Academic Integrity Principles
•	All assignments must be original; plagiarism, ghostwriting, or resubmitting previous work is prohibited.
•	When using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT), please specify the purpose and source.
•	Correctly cite the sources when referencing others' data or designs.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
預習與課後任務
•	請事前預習指定教材，並於課後完成延伸練習。
•	若有課堂練習未完成，請於一週內補交。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Pre-reading and After-class Tasks
•	Please review the assigned materials before class and complete the extension exercises after class. 
•	If any in-class exercises are not completed, please submit them within a week.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
學術誠信聲明（Academic Integrity Statement）
學術誠信是大學學習的基礎，是每一位學生應該秉持的核心價值。誠信不僅意味著不抄襲、不作弊，更是尊重知識、尊重他人與尊重自己努力成果的展現。
 
✅ 誠信原則
  • 原創作品：您所提交的報告、簡報、設計作品、考試答案等，應為您個人或小組的原創內容。不得冒用他人作品、或重複使用過去在其他課程中已提交過的內容，除非事前獲得授權與老師同意。
  • 正確引用：若引用他人觀點、研究、資料或設計素材，請明確標示出處，無論來源是書籍、期刊、網站、AI生成內容或社群媒體。
  • AI工具使用原則：
    • 允許在特定任務中使用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT、Midjourney、Canva 等），但必須誠實揭露使用情況，並對產出的內容負責任地編輯與判讀。
    • 不得將 AI 全自動產出的內容直接當作自己作品交付，否則視為違反學術誠信。
    • 若不確定某種用法是否合規，請主動與老師討論。
  • 團隊合作與個人責任：
    • 團體作業中，每位成員皆應分工明確並對成果負責，不可讓他人代為完成。
    • 在小組內相互協助是鼓勵的，但請避免在應為個人完成的作業或考試中共同作答或交換答案。
❌ 違反學術誠信的後果
任何違反上述誠信規則之行為，將依照學校相關規範處理，可能包含：
  • 作業成績以零分計
  • 整學期成績不予採計
  • 通報系辦或教務單位等紀律處分
提醒
如果您對某項作業的完成方式、引用格式、AI工具的合理使用方式不確定，請務必事前詢問老師或助教，不要讓疑慮變成風險。學術誠信不只是約束，更是建立專業與信任的基礎。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity Statement
Academic integrity is the foundation of university learning and a core value that every student should uphold. Integrity not only means avoiding plagiarism and cheating, but also demonstrates respect for knowledge, others, and the fruits of one's own efforts.
✅ Principles of Integrity
  • Original Work：The reports, presentations, design works, exam answers, etc., that you submit should be your own original content or created by your group. You are not allowed to plagiarize others' works or reuse content previously submitted in other courses, unless prior authorization and approval from the instructor are obtained.
  • Proper Citation：If you quote other people’s opinions, research, information or design materials, please clearly indicate the source, whether the source is a book, journal, website, AI-generated content or social media.
  • AI Tool Usage Principles：
    • AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva, etc.) are allowed to be used for specific tasks, but the usage must be transparently disclosed. Additionally, you must take responsibility for editing and interpreting the generated content.
    • AI-generated content must not be submitted as your own work without modification. Doing so will be considered a violation of academic integrity.
    • If you are unsure whether a certain use is compliant, please proactively discuss it with your instructor.
  • Teamwork and Individual Responsibility：
    • In group projects, every member should have a clearly defined role and take responsibility for the final outcome. Delegating one's work to others is not allowed.
    • Mutual support within the group is encouraged, but please avoid collaborating or sharing answers on assignments or exams that are meant to be completed individually.
❌ Teamwork and Individual Responsibility
Any behavior that violates the above integrity rules will be handled according to the university's relevant regulations, which may include：
  • Assigning a grade of zero for the assignment.
  • Excluding the entire semester's grade from consideration.
  • Reporting to the department or academic affairs office for disciplinary action.
Reminder
If you are uncertain about how to complete an assignment, the correct citation format, or the proper use of AI tools, be sure to ask the instructor or teaching assistant beforehand. Do not let doubts turn into risks. Academic integrity is not only a set of rules, but also the foundation for building professionalism and trust.

Do not let doubts turn into risks. Academic integrity is not only a set of rules, but also the foundation for building professionalism and trust.

policy.course_pol:
課堂規則與提醒（Classroom Policies & Guidelines）
為營造尊重、多元與專業的學習環境，請同學遵守以下課堂規則：
1.出席與課堂參與
•	準時上課，並完整參與課堂活動。
•	若有特殊狀況需遲到或早退，請事先告知老師。
•	缺課需補交指定補充作業，以確保學習進度。
2.數位設備使用
•	鼓勵使用筆電或平板進行課堂筆記與設計練習。
•	非與課程無關之操作（如：社群滑手機、觀看影片等）請避免。
•	手機請設定靜音，上課期間不建議配戴耳機。
3.課堂互動與簡報
•	尊重同學發言，專心聆聽小組報告與簡報分享。
•	表達意見時以正向、專業且具建設性的態度為原則。
•	鼓勵多元觀點、包容差異，彼此尊重學習過程。
4.學術誠信原則
•	所有作業須為原創，不得抄襲、代筆或重複提交已交作品。
•	使用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT）輔助時，請註明用途與來源。
•	引用他人資料或設計時，請正確註明出處。
policy.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
Classroom Policies & Guidelines
To foster a respectful, diverse, and professional learning environment, students are expected to adhere to the following classroom rules：
1.Attendance and Classroom Participation
•	Be on time for class and actively participate in classroom activities. 
•	If you need to be late or leave early due to special circumstances, please inform the instructor in advance. 
•	If you miss a class, you must submit the designated supplementary assignments to ensure you stay on track with the course. 
2.Digital Device Usage 
•	Laptops or tablets are encouraged for note-taking and design exercises.
•	Please avoid non-course-related activities (e.g., browsing social media, watching videos).
•	Set your phone to silent, and wearing headphones during class is not recommended.
3. Class Interaction and Presentations
•	Respect your classmates' speaking time and actively listen to group reports and presentations.
•	When expressing opinions, maintain a positive, professional, and constructive attitude. 
•	Encourage diverse perspectives, embrace differences, and respect the learning process. 
4. Academic Integrity Principles
•	All assignments must be original; plagiarism, ghostwriting, or resubmitting previous work is prohibited.
•	When using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT), please specify the purpose and source.
•	Correctly cite the sources when referencing others' data or designs.
policy.course_rem:
預習與課後任務
•	請事前預習指定教材，並於課後完成延伸練習。
•	若有課堂練習未完成，請於一週內補交。
policy.course_rem_en:
Pre-reading and After-class Tasks
•	Please review the assigned materials before class and complete the extension exercises after class. 
•	If any in-class exercises are not completed, please submit them within a week.
policy.ais_meno:
學術誠信聲明（Academic Integrity Statement）
學術誠信是大學學習的基礎，是每一位學生應該秉持的核心價值。誠信不僅意味著不抄襲、不作弊，更是尊重知識、尊重他人與尊重自己努力成果的展現。
 
✅ 誠信原則
  • 原創作品：您所提交的報告、簡報、設計作品、考試答案等，應為您個人或小組的原創內容。不得冒用他人作品、或重複使用過去在其他課程中已提交過的內容，除非事前獲得授權與老師同意。
  • 正確引用：若引用他人觀點、研究、資料或設計素材，請明確標示出處，無論來源是書籍、期刊、網站、AI生成內容或社群媒體。
  • AI工具使用原則：
    • 允許在特定任務中使用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT、Midjourney、Canva 等），但必須誠實揭露使用情況，並對產出的內容負責任地編輯與判讀。
    • 不得將 AI 全自動產出的內容直接當作自己作品交付，否則視為違反學術誠信。
    • 若不確定某種用法是否合規，請主動與老師討論。
  • 團隊合作與個人責任：
    • 團體作業中，每位成員皆應分工明確並對成果負責，不可讓他人代為完成。
    • 在小組內相互協助是鼓勵的，但請避免在應為個人完成的作業或考試中共同作答或交換答案。
❌ 違反學術誠信的後果
任何違反上述誠信規則之行為，將依照學校相關規範處理，可能包含：
  • 作業成績以零分計
  • 整學期成績不予採計
  • 通報系辦或教務單位等紀律處分
提醒
如果您對某項作業的完成方式、引用格式、AI工具的合理使用方式不確定，請務必事前詢問老師或助教，不要讓疑慮變成風險。學術誠信不只是約束，更是建立專業與信任的基礎。
policy.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity Statement
Academic integrity is the foundation of university learning and a core value that every student should uphold. Integrity not only means avoiding plagiarism and cheating, but also demonstrates respect for knowledge, others, and the fruits of one's own efforts.
✅ Principles of Integrity
  • Original Work：The reports, presentations, design works, exam answers, etc., that you submit should be your own original content or created by your group. You are not allowed to plagiarize others' works or reuse content previously submitted in other courses, unless prior authorization and approval from the instructor are obtained.
  • Proper Citation：If you quote other people’s opinions, research, information or design materials, please clearly indicate the source, whether the source is a book, journal, website, AI-generated content or social media.
  • AI Tool Usage Principles：
    • AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva, etc.) are allowed to be used for specific tasks, but the usage must be transparently disclosed. Additionally, you must take responsibility for editing and interpreting the generated content.
    • AI-generated content must not be submitted as your own work without modification. Doing so will be considered a violation of academic integrity.
    • If you are unsure whether a certain use is compliant, please proactively discuss it with your instructor.
  • Teamwork and Individual Responsibility：
    • In group projects, every member should have a clearly defined role and take responsibility for the final outcome. Delegating one's work to others is not allowed.
    • Mutual support within the group is encouraged, but please avoid collaborating or sharing answers on assignments or exams that are meant to be completed individually.
❌ Teamwork and Individual Responsibility
Any behavior that violates the above integrity rules will be handled according to the university's relevant regulations, which may include：
  • Assigning a grade of zero for the assignment.
  • Excluding the entire semester's grade from consideration.
  • Reporting to the department or academic affairs office for disciplinary action.
Reminder
If you are uncertain about how to complete an assignment, the correct citation format, or the proper use of AI tools, be sure to ask the instructor or teaching assistant beforehand. Do not let doubts turn into risks. Academic integrity is not only a set of rules, but also the foundation for building professionalism and trust.
